notifications.description: List your unread GitHub notifications (needs sign-in)

trending.description: Trending GitHub repositories today, optionally for one language, as JSON

language.description: Language, e.g. python, rust, typescript (empty for all)

search_repos.description: Search GitHub repositories with qualifiers (stars, created, pushed, topic, language). Returns the results page as text: repo, description, topics, language, stars, last updated.

query.description: GitHub search query with qualifiers, spaces as +, e.g. created:>2026-10-27+stars:150..900+topic:ai-agents

sort.description: Sort field: stars, forks, updated, or empty for best match
